high_level_description: This image is a collage of four photos posted by the verified Instagram user @aliaabhatt. The post includes a fan with intricate white floral patterns on a gray background, and three embroidered pieces of fabric with monogrammed initials. Top Photo: A hand-fan with a wooden frame and delicate white floral designs on a gray background. The fan appears to be closed, and the design is symmetrical, radiating from the center. Second Photo: A close-up of an embroidered piece of fabric with the initials "R" and "K" in cursive script. The embroidery is done in a dark thread
